name: Eiscafe Bolina
kurzbeschreibung:
**Ice Café Bolina in Pfronten**

Indulge in the finest **Eis** (ice cream) in the heart of the **Allgäu**! At **Eiscafe Bolina** in **Pfronten**, you’ll find creamy, homemade flavors crafted with love—from classic **Vanille** and **Schokolade** to unique specialties like **Zitrone** with a hint of **Bergkäse** or **Erdbeere** with **Basilikum**.

The cozy café, nestled near the **Breitachklamm** gorge, offers a perfect break after a day of hiking in the **Allgäuer Alpen**. Try their famous **Kaiserschmarrn** with fresh **Obst** (fruit) or a warm **Apfelstrudel**—both made with local ingredients.

Whether you’re exploring **Tirol** or just passing through, **Eiscafe Bolina** is a must-visit for sweet treats and alpine charm. Enjoy your **Eis** with a view of the stunning **Breitachklamm** or the **Hochtannbergbahn** cable car station!
